name: Ring of the Twin
body:
Aura faint illusion; CL 5th; Slot ring; Price 30,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This dual band ring allows the wearer to create an illusory double within 20 feet of herself. Controlling the double is a swift action.

The double, while it can not damage opponents, may be used for flanking an opponent, but doing so imposes a -2 penalty to the wearer’s attack rolls. Special abilities requiring a flanked opponent, such as sneak attack, precise strike and outflank, function normally. If the double is successfully attacked, it disappears.

The double can be called up to 5 rounds/day. These rounds need not be consecutive.

Creatures immune to illusions or that can sense life recognize the twin for what it is. As such, they are not susceptible to flank attacks made using the ring’s double.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells major image; Cost 15,000 gp

Identification DC 20
